newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling gains against dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling gains against dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling gained against the dollar and pound on Monday, exchanging at a commercial mean rate of 594.7425 to the dollar compared to Friday's 594.9900, the central Bank of Tanzania said.
Against the pound, the shilling exchanged for 991.3480 against Friday's mean rate of 992.4463.
Dealers said they expected the shilling to continue to rise this week and stabilise near 590 shillings to the dollar.
